7 of 9 members present. Quorum established.

Agenda
Item 1
Regional Business Review: EMEA

The committee reviewed the Regional Business Review: EMEA, a proposal to enter the 14 market. The discussion focused on the competitive landscape and the regulatory hurdles. The committee approved a budget for a feasibility study.

Item 2
Change-in-Control Severance Plan Review

The Change-in-Control Severance Plan Review was presented by Kyle Berger. After a short clarifying discussion, the committee members agreed that the matter was straightforward and did not require extensive debate. The motion to approve was passed without dissent.

Motion

To approve for profitability: RESOLVED, that the Regulatory Response Committee approves the selection of Cheshire Consulting as the vendor for the Change-in-Control Severance Plan Review and authorizes management to execute the final contract.

Moved: Akanni Hernandez  •  Seconded: Onur Munoz
Vote: 7 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 3
Earnings Release and Guidance Review

The committee reviewed the Earnings Release and Guidance Review and the associated analysis in Exhibit C. The discussion focused on the risk-reward trade-off. A motion to approve the expenditure was made, contingent on a final review by the legal department.

Item 4
Ethics and Compliance Program Annual Report

Zach Khalil summarized findings from the Ethics and Compliance Program Annual Report review, covering the period ending 2012-01-09. The committee noted 17 employees affected across 14 locations in the SALT Advisory Services sector. A motion was introduced following discussion. See motion record below. Exhibit D contains the full supporting analysis.

Item 5
Pay Equity Audit Findings and Remediation Plan

The committee considered the Pay Equity Audit Findings and Remediation Plan, a proposal to adopt a new policy on trade secrets. The policy was approved and will be implemented company-wide.

Motion

To approve for release: RESOLVED, that the Regulatory Response Committee approves the formation of a new subsidiary, Cheshire Consulting, to pursue the Pay Equity Audit Findings and Remediation Plan.

Moved: Mere Weiss  •  Seconded: Akanni Hernandez
Vote: 5 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  2 Abstain  —  CARRIED
